name: semantic
title: Semantic
description: Almost no CSS. Clean, classless HTML from a tiny template, with pages that show every Markdown construct so you can see the markup you will be styling.

demo.tagline: A site that documents its own markup

features: One eight-line stylesheet you can delete
Semantic landmarks: header, nav, main, article, aside, footer
Site menu and breadcrumbs from SMGen core
Light and dark through the browser's own colour scheme

sampleContent.purpose: Every Markdown construct and the HTML it produces
Two short guides: writing pages and adding a stylesheet
About page; says the site is a demo

notes: static/base.css sets a reading measure and colour-scheme; remove it for pure browser defaults
The menu is the core tree renderer over the pages directory, so new pages appear automatically
